request_user:
Fact: target_systems
What to find: Type and nature of AI systems the model can be integrated into (e.g. assistants, agents, RAG, decision support).
Card sections that often contain it: Intended Use, Use Cases, Downstream Use

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Can be used in agentic systems via tool calling (XML/JSON tool calls or Python-style tool calls), deployed as an OpenAI-compatible API via vLLM and SGLang, and used as an assistive tool; supports custom system instructions and hybrid reasoning (think/no_think).
quotes: You can use vLLM and SGLang to deploy the model in an API compatible with OpenAI format.
These models should be used as assistive tools rather than definitive sources of information.
You can specify custom instruction through the system prompt while controlling whether to use extended thinking.
